_comment: ROSTER + OFFLINE FALLBACK ONLY as of the live-data rework: the app now fetches win rates / counters / synergies from the OpenMLBB public API (see network/OpenMlbbClient.kt) at calculation time and never needs this file hand-updated for stats again. This file still supplies (a) the hero roster/icon keys/roles, since those map to bundled icon art the API cannot provide, and (b) a same-shaped offline fallback dataset used only when the live fetch fails (no signal, API down, unexpected response shape) so the app keeps working with dated-but-reasonable numbers instead of breaking. The fallback numbers here are grounded in the GameMarket.gg Patch 2.1.90 (July 2026) meta tier list plus longstanding, multi-source MLBB community consensus for kit-interaction counters/synergies -- see DATA_SOURCE_PROMPT.md for how to refresh the roster and this fallback snapshot occasionally (a season or two apart is plenty, since it is now a safety net, not the primary data path).
